page_title: Blink Eye - Best Eye Care & Break Reminder for Mac, Windows, Linux

summary.name: Blink Eye
summary.one_liner: Blink Eye is an eye-care app that reminds you to take 20-20-20 breaks and tracks daily screen time and streaks.
use_cases: Remembering 20-20-20 eye breaks during long computer sessions
Reducing eye strain while working remotely
Staying focused with break timers and a task manager
summary.what_it_does: Blink Eye shows a dashboard with a live countdown to the next 20-20-20 eye break, with pause and resume controls. It displays today's screen time and a streak at a glance. The page says it has customizable break timers and a built-in task manager, and that it offers 11 tools reachable in one click. It uses a native-style layout with sidebar navigation. The page does not describe how the tools or tracking work in detail.
notable: Live countdown to next 20-20-20 eye break with pause and resume
Built-in task manager and customizable break timers
Dashboard with today's screen time and streak
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Page text is mostly marketing; specific platform builds are not detailed beyond the title
